cover_letter_text:
Hello,

I am applying for the Site Engineer role in Gympie, which I saw on SEEK. Your advert says from day one the role takes off quantities, keeps quality records, coordinates subcontractors and carries out onsite inspections on live projects.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on two sites in the Philippines. On a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings, checked work against project requirements and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials, prepared site reports, material records and progress reports, and coordinated with subcontractors and suppliers. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019) and an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design (February 2026), where I designed road geometry, earthworks and stormwater drainage and prepared bills of quantities.

I am based in Melton VIC. I will relocate to Gympie for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. I hold a full Victorian driver's licence and a White Card. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Marc Masarate
